MSDN IDirect3DDevice9Ex::ComposeRects (source and destination must be D3DFMT_A1 surfaces, source D3DUSAGE_TEXTAPI); PROOF no such surface exists: env CheckDeviceFormat = D3DERR_NOTAVAILABLE for A1 (every usage, every resource type but buffers) and for D3DUSAGE_TEXTAPI (every format), nx_texfmt(D3DFMT_A1) has no layout, tests/l6/m1 part c creates every D3DFORMAT through every creator and finds no A1; hence D3DERR_INVALIDCALL (0x8876086C) for every argument (m1_misc.cpp)

wine-9.0:dlls/d3d9/d3d9_main.c:DebugSetMute `/* nothing to do */` (no log line in Wine); D3DX (d3dx9_31 / d3dx9_38) calls it with one word it removes itself and ignores the result; the only effect an application could name is the debug runtime's output, and this layer has no debug output channel (ENV-TRUTH)
